ayahs.ar: تَبٰرَكَ الَّذِيۡ نَزَّلَ الۡفُرۡقَانَ عَلٰي عَبۡدِهٖ لِيَكُوۡنَ لِلۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ نَذِيۡرَاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Tabaarakal lazee nazzalal Furqaana 'alaa 'abdihee li yakoona lil'aalameena nazeera
ayahs.en: Blessed is He who sent down the Criterion upon His Servant that he may be to the worlds a warner -

ayahs.ar: اِۨلَّذِيۡ لَهٗ مُلۡكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَلَمۡ يَتَّخِذۡ وَلَدًا وَّلَمۡ يَكُنۡ لَّهٗ شَرِيۡكٌ فِي الۡمُلۡكِ وَخَلَقَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ فَقَدَّرَهٗ تَقۡدِيۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Allazee lahoo mulkus samaawaati wal ardi wa lam yattakhiz waladanw wa lam yakul lahoo shareekun filmulki wa khalaqa kulla shai'in faqaddarahoo taqdeeraa
ayahs.en: He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and who has not taken a son and has not had a partner in dominion and has created each thing and determined it with [precise] determination.

ayahs.ar: وَاتَّخَذُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ٘ اٰلِهَةً لَّا يَخۡلُقُوۡنَ شَيۡـًٔا وَّهُمۡ يُخۡلَقُوۡنَ وَلَا يَمۡلِكُوۡنَ لِاَنۡفُسِهِمۡ ضَرًّا وَّلَا نَفۡعًا وَّلَا يَمۡلِكُوۡنَ مَوۡتًا وَّلَا حَيٰوةً وَّلَا نُشُوۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Wattakhazoo min dooniheee aahihatal laa yakhluqoona shai'anw wa hum yukhlaqoona wa laa yamlikoona li anfusihim darranw wa laa naf'anw wa laa yamlikoona mawtanw wa laa hayaatanw wa laa nushooraa
ayahs.en: But they have taken besides Him gods which create nothing, while they are created, and possess not for themselves any harm or benefit and possess not [power to cause] death or life or resurrection.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡ٘ا اِنۡ هٰذَا٘ اِلَّا٘ اِفۡكُ اِۨفۡتَرٰىهُ وَاَعَانَهٗ عَلَيۡهِ قَوۡمٌ اٰخَرُوۡنَۚۛ فَقَدۡ جَآءُوۡ ظُلۡمًا وَّزُوۡرًاۚۛ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalal lazeena kafarooo in haazaaa illaaa ifkunif taraahu wa a'aanahoo 'alaihi qawmun aakharoona faqad jaaa'oo zulmanw wa zooraa
ayahs.en: And those who disbelieve say, "This [Qur'an] is not except a falsehood he invented, and another people assisted him in it." But they have committed an injustice and a lie.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوۡ٘ا اَسَاطِيۡرُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ اكۡتَتَبَهَا فَهِيَ تُمۡلٰي عَلَيۡهِ بُكۡرَةً وَّاَصِيۡلًا
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalooo asaateerul awwaleenak tatabahaa fahiya tumlaa 'alaihi bukratanw wa aseelaa
ayahs.en: And they say, "Legends of the former peoples which he has written down, and they are dictated to him morning and afternoon."

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اَنۡزَلَهُ الَّذِيۡ يَعۡلَمُ السِّرَّ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ غَفُوۡرًا رَّحِيۡمًا
ayahs.tl: Qul anzalhul lazee ya'lamus sirra fis samaawaati wal-ard; innahoo kaana Ghafoorar Raheemaa
ayahs.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "It has been revealed by He who knows [every] secret within the heavens and the earth. Indeed, He is ever Forgiving and Merciful."

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوۡا مَالِ هٰذَا الرَّسُوۡلِ يَاۡكُلُ الطَّعَامَ وَيَمۡشِيۡ فِي الۡاَسۡوَاقِؕ لَوۡلَا٘ اُنۡزِلَ اِلَيۡهِ مَلَكٌ فَيَكُوۡنَ مَعَهٗ نَذِيۡرًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa qaaloo maa li haazar Rasooli yaakulut ta'aama wa yamshee fil aswaaq; law laaa unzila ilaihi malakun fa yakoona ma'ahoo nazeeraa
ayahs.en: And they say, "What is this messenger that eats food and walks in the markets? Why was there not sent down to him an angel so he would be with him a warner?

ayahs.ar: اَوۡ يُلۡقٰ٘ي اِلَيۡهِ كَنۡزٌ اَوۡ تَكُوۡنُ لَهٗ جَنَّةٌ يَّاۡكُلُ مِنۡهَاؕ وَقَالَ الظّٰلِمُوۡنَ اِنۡ تَتَّبِعُوۡنَ اِلَّا رَجُلًا مَّسۡحُوۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Aw yulqaaa ilaihi kanzun aw takoonu lahoo jannatuny yaakulu minhaa; wa qaalaz zaalimoona in tattabi'oona illaa rajulam mas hooraa
ayahs.en: Or [why is not] a treasure presented to him [from heaven], or does he [not] have a garden from which he eats?" And the wrongdoers say, "You follow not but a man affected by magic."

ayahs.ar: اُنۡظُرۡ كَيۡفَ ضَرَبُوۡا لَكَ الۡاَمۡثَالَ فَضَلُّوۡا فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَ سَبِيۡلًاࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Unzur kaifa daraboo lakal amsaala fadalloo falaa yastatee'oona sabeelaa
ayahs.en: Look how they strike for you comparisons; but they have strayed, so they cannot [find] a way.

ayahs.ar: تَبٰرَكَ الَّذِيۡ٘ اِنۡ شَآءَ جَعَلَ لَكَ خَيۡرًا مِّنۡ ذٰلِكَ جَنّٰتٍ تَجۡرِيۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَا الۡاَنۡهٰرُۙ وَيَجۡعَلۡ لَّكَ قُصُوۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Tabaarakal lazeee in shaaa'a ja'ala laka khairam min zaalika jannaatin tajree min tahtihal anhaaru wa yaj'al laka qusooraa
ayahs.en: Blessed is He who, if He willed, could have made for you [something] better than that - gardens beneath which rivers flow - and could make for you palaces.

ayahs.ar: بَلۡ كَذَّبُوۡا بِالسَّاعَةِ وَاَعۡتَدۡنَا لِمَنۡ كَذَّبَ بِالسَّاعَةِ سَعِيۡرًاۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Bal kazzaboo bis Saa'ati wa a'tadnaa liman kazzaba bis Saa'ati sa'eeraa
ayahs.en: But they have denied the Hour, and We have prepared for those who deny the Hour a Blaze.

ayahs.ar: اِذَا رَاَتۡهُمۡ مِّنۡ مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيۡدٍ سَمِعُوۡا لَهَا تَغَيُّظًا وَّزَفِيۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Izaa ra'at hum mim ma kaanim ba'eedin sami'oo lahaa taghaiyuzanw wa zafeeraa
ayahs.en: When the Hellfire sees them from a distant place, they will hear its fury and roaring.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا٘ اُلۡقُوۡا مِنۡهَا مَكَانًا ضَيِّقًا مُّقَرَّنِيۡنَ دَعَوۡا هُنَالِكَ ثُبُوۡرًاؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa izaaa ulqoo minhaa makaanan daiyiqam muqar raneena da'aw hunaalika subooraa
ayahs.en: And when they are thrown into a narrow place therein bound in chains, they will cry out thereupon for destruction.

ayahs.ar: لَا تَدۡعُوا الۡيَوۡمَ ثُبُوۡرًا وَّاحِدًا وَّادۡعُوۡا ثُبُوۡرًا كَثِيۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Laa tad'ul yawma subooranw waahidanw wad'oo subooran kaseeraa
ayahs.en: [They will be told], "Do not cry this Day for one destruction but cry for much destruction."

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اَذٰلِكَ خَيۡرٌ اَمۡ جَنَّةُ الۡخُلۡدِ الَّتِيۡ وُعِدَ الۡمُتَّقُوۡنَؕ كَانَتۡ لَهُمۡ جَزَآءً وَّمَصِيۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Qul azaalika khairun am Jannatul khuldil latee wu'idal muttaqoon; kaanat lahum jazaaa'anw wa maseeraa
ayahs.en: Say, "Is that better or the Garden of Eternity which is promised to the righteous? It will be for them a reward and destination.

ayahs.ar: لَهُمۡ فِيۡهَا مَا يَشَآءُوۡنَ خٰلِدِيۡنَؕ كَانَ عَلٰي رَبِّكَ وَعۡدًا مَّسۡـُٔوۡلًا
ayahs.tl: Lahum feehaa maa yashaaa'oona khaalideen; kaana 'alaa Rabbika wa'dam mas'oolaa
ayahs.en: For them therein is whatever they wish, [while] abiding eternally. It is ever upon your Lord a promise [worthy to be] requested.

ayahs.ar: وَيَوۡمَ يَحۡشُرُهُمۡ وَمَا يَعۡبُدُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ فَيَقُوۡلُ ءَاَنۡتُمۡ اَضۡلَلۡتُمۡ عِبَادِيۡ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ اَمۡ هُمۡ ضَلُّوا السَّبِيۡلَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa Yawma yahshuruhum wa maa ya'budoona min doonil lahi fa yaqoolu 'a-antum adlaltum 'ibaadee haaa'ulaaa'i am hum dallus sabeel
ayahs.en: And [mention] the Day He will gather them and that which they worship besides Allah and will say, "Did you mislead these, My servants, or did they [themselves] stray from the way?"

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا سُبۡحٰنَكَ مَا كَانَ يَنۭۡ بَغِيۡ لَنَا٘ اَنۡ نَّتَّخِذَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِكَ مِنۡ اَوۡلِيَآءَ وَلٰكِنۡ مَّتَّعۡتَهُمۡ وَاٰبَآءَهُمۡ حَتّٰي نَسُوا الذِّكۡرَۚ وَكَانُوۡا قَوۡمًاۭ بُوۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo Subhaanaka maa kaana yambaghee lanaaa an nattakhiza min doonika min awliyaaa'a wa laakim matta'tahum wa aabaaa'ahum hattaa nasuz zikra wa kaanoo qawmam booraa
ayahs.en: They will say, "Exalted are You! It was not for us to take besides You any allies. But You provided comforts for them and their fathers until they forgot the message and became a people ruined."

ayahs.ar: فَقَدۡ كَذَّبُوۡكُمۡ بِمَا تَقُوۡلُوۡنَۙ فَمَا تَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَ صَرۡفًا وَّلَا نَصۡرًاۚ وَمَنۡ يَّظۡلِمۡ مِّنۡكُمۡ نُذِقۡهُ عَذَابًا كَبِيۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Faqad kazzabookum bimaa taqooloona famaa tastatee'oona sarfanw wa laa nasraa; wa mai yazlim minkum nuziqhu 'azaaban kabeeraa
ayahs.en: So they will deny you, [disbelievers], in what you say, and you cannot avert [punishment] or [find] help. And whoever commits injustice among you - We will make him taste a great punishment.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنَا قَبۡلَكَ مِنَ الۡمُرۡسَلِيۡنَ اِلَّا٘ اِنَّهُمۡ لَيَاۡكُلُوۡنَ الطَّعَامَ وَيَمۡشُوۡنَ فِي الۡاَسۡوَاقِؕ وَجَعَلۡنَا بَعۡضَكُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ فِتۡنَةًؕ اَتَصۡبِرُوۡنَۚ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ بَصِيۡرًاࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa maaa arsalnaa qablaka minal mursaleena illaaa innahum la yaakuloonat ta'aama wa yamshoona fil aswaaq; wa ja'alnaa ba'dakum liba'din fitnatan atasbiroon; wa kaana Rabbuka Baseera
ayahs.en: And We did not send before you, [O Muhammad], any of the messengers except that they ate food and walked in the markets. And We have made some of you [people] as trial for others - will you have patience? And ever is your Lord, Seeing.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يَرۡجُوۡنَ لِقَآءَنَا لَوۡلَا٘ اُنۡزِلَ عَلَيۡنَا الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةُ اَوۡ نَرٰي رَبَّنَاؕ لَقَدِ اسۡتَكۡبَرُوۡا فِيۡ٘ اَنۡفُسِهِمۡ وَعَتَوۡ عُتُوًّا كَبِيۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalal lazeena laa yarjoona liqaaa'anaa law laaa unzila 'alainal malaaa'ikatu awnaraa Rabbanaa; laqadistakbaroo feee anfusihim wa 'ataw 'utuwwan kabeeraa
ayahs.en: And those who do not expect the meeting with Us say, "Why were not angels sent down to us, or [why] do we [not] see our Lord?" They have certainly become arrogant within themselves and [become] insolent with great insolence.

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَ يَرَوۡنَ الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةَ لَا بُشۡرٰي يَوۡمَئِذٍ لِّلۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَ وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ حِجۡرًا مَّحۡجُوۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Yawma yarawnal malaaa 'ikata laa bushraa Yawma'izil lilmujrimeena wa yaqooloona hijram mahjooraa
ayahs.en: The day they see the angels - no good tidings will there be that day for the criminals, and [the angels] will say, "Prevented and inaccessible."

ayahs.ar: وَقَدِمۡنَا٘ اِلٰي مَا عَمِلُوۡا مِنۡ عَمَلٍ فَجَعَلۡنٰهُ هَبَآءً مَّنۡثُوۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Wa qadimnaaa ilaa maa 'amiloo min 'amalin faja'alnaahu habaaa'am mansooraa
ayahs.en: And We will regard what they have done of deeds and make them as dust dispersed.

ayahs.ar: اَصۡحٰبُ الۡجَنَّةِ يَوۡمَئِذٍ خَيۡرٌ مُّسۡتَقَرًّا وَّاَحۡسَنُ مَقِيۡلًا
ayahs.tl: As haabul jannati yawma'izin khairum mustaqar ranw wa ahsanu maqeela
ayahs.en: The companions of Paradise, that Day, are [in] a better settlement and better resting place.

ayahs.ar: وَيَوۡمَ تَشَقَّقُ السَّمَآءُ بِالۡغَمَامِ وَنُزِّلَ الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةُ تَنۡزِيۡلًا
ayahs.tl: Wa Yawma tashaqqaqus samaaa'u bilghamaami wa nuzzilal malaaa'ikatu tanzeela
ayahs.en: And [mention] the Day when the heaven will split open with [emerging] clouds, and the angels will be sent down in successive descent.

ayahs.ar: اَلۡمُلۡكُ يَوۡمَئِذِ اِۨلۡحَقُّ لِلرَّحۡمٰنِؕ وَكَانَ يَوۡمًا عَلَي الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ عَسِيۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Almulku Yawma'izinil haqqu lir Rahmaan; wa kaana Yawman'alal kaafireena 'aseeraa
ayahs.en: True sovereignty, that Day, is for the Most Merciful. And it will be upon the disbelievers a difficult Day.

ayahs.ar: وَيَوۡمَ يَعَضُّ الظَّالِمُ عَلٰي يَدَيۡهِ يَقُوۡلُ يٰلَيۡتَنِي اتَّخَذۡتُ مَعَ الرَّسُوۡلِ سَبِيۡلًا
ayahs.tl: Wa Yawma ya'adduz zaalimu 'alaa yadaihi yaqoolu yaa laitanit takhaztu ma'ar Rasooli sabeelaa
ayahs.en: And the Day the wrongdoer will bite on his hands [in regret] he will say, "Oh, I wish I had taken with the Messenger a way.

ayahs.ar: يٰوَيۡلَتٰي لَيۡتَنِيۡ لَمۡ اَتَّخِذۡ فُلَانًا خَلِيۡلًا
ayahs.tl: Yaa wailataa laitanee lam attakhiz fulaanan khaleelaa
ayahs.en: Oh, woe to me! I wish I had not taken that one as a friend.

ayahs.ar: لَقَدۡ اَضَلَّنِيۡ عَنِ الذِّكۡرِ بَعۡدَ اِذۡ جَآءَنِيۡؕ وَكَانَ الشَّيۡطٰنُ لِلۡاِنۡسَانِ خَذُوۡلًا
ayahs.tl: Laqad adallanee 'aniz zikri ba'da iz jaaa'anee; wa kaanash Shaitaanu lil insaani khazoolaa
ayahs.en: He led me away from the remembrance after it had come to me. And ever is Satan, to man, a deserter."

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ الرَّسُوۡلُ يٰرَبِّ اِنَّ قَوۡمِي اتَّخَذُوۡا هٰذَا الۡقُرۡاٰنَ مَهۡجُوۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalar Rasoolu yaa Rabbi inna qawmit takhazoo haazal Qur-aana mahjooraa
ayahs.en: And the Messenger has said, "O my Lord, indeed my people have taken this Qur'an as [a thing] abandoned."

ayahs.ar: وَكَذٰلِكَ جَعَلۡنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ عَدُوًّا مِّنَ الۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَؕ وَكَفٰي بِرَبِّكَ هَادِيًا وَّنَصِيۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Wa kazaalika ja'alnaa likulli Nabiyyin 'aduwwam minal mujrimeen; wa kafaa bi Rabbika haadiyanw wa naseeraa
ayahs.en: And thus have We made for every prophet an enemy from among the criminals. But sufficient is your Lord as a guide and a helper.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا لَوۡلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيۡهِ الۡقُرۡاٰنُ جُمۡلَةً وَّاحِدَةًۚۛ كَذٰلِكَۚۛ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهٖ فُؤَادَكَ وَرَتَّلۡنٰهُ تَرۡتِيۡلًا
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalal lazeena kafaroo law laa nuzzila 'alaihil Quraanu jumlatanw waahidah; kazaalika linusabbita bihee fu'aadaka wa rattalnaahu tarteelaa
ayahs.en: And those who disbelieve say, "Why was the Qur'an not revealed to him all at once?" Thus [it is] that We may strengthen thereby your heart. And We have spaced it distinctly.

ayahs.ar: وَلَا يَاۡتُوۡنَكَ بِمَثَلٍ اِلَّا جِئۡنٰكَ بِالۡحَقِّ وَاَحۡسَنَ تَفۡسِيۡرًاؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa laa yaatoonaka bimasainn illaa ji'naaka bilhaqqi wa ahsana tafseeraa
ayahs.en: And they do not come to you with an argument except that We bring you the truth and the best explanation.

ayahs.ar: اَلَّذِيۡنَ يُحۡشَرُوۡنَ عَلٰي وُجُوۡهِهِمۡ اِلٰي جَهَنَّمَۙ اُولٰٓئِكَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَّاَضَلُّ سَبِيۡلًاࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Allazeena yuhsharoona 'alaa wujoohim ilaa jahannama ulaaa'ika sharrum makaananw wa adallu sabeelaa )section 3)
ayahs.en: The ones who are gathered on their faces to Hell - those are the worst in position and farthest astray in [their] way.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنَا مُوۡسَي الۡكِتٰبَ وَجَعَلۡنَا مَعَهٗ٘ اَخَاهُ هٰرُوۡنَ وَزِيۡرًاۚۖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad aatainaa Moosal Kitaaba wa ja'alnaa ma'ahooo akhaahu Haaroona wazeeraa
ayahs.en: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture and appointed with him his brother Aaron as an assistant.

ayahs.ar: فَقُلۡنَا اذۡهَبَا٘ اِلَي الۡقَوۡمِ الَّذِيۡنَ كَذَّبُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَاؕ فَدَمَّرۡنٰهُمۡ تَدۡمِيۡرًاؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Faqulnaz habaaa ilal qawmil lazeena kazzaboo bi Aayaatinaa fadammarnaahum tadmeeraa
ayahs.en: And We said, "Go both of you to the people who have denied Our signs." Then We destroyed them with [complete] destruction.

ayahs.ar: وَقَوۡمَ نُوۡحٍ لَّمَّا كَذَّبُوا الرُّسُلَ اَغۡرَقۡنٰهُمۡ وَجَعَلۡنٰهُمۡ لِلنَّاسِ اٰيَةًؕ وَاَعۡتَدۡنَا لِلظّٰلِمِيۡنَ عَذَابًا اَلِيۡمًاۚۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa qawma Noohil lammaa kazzabur Rusula aghraqnaahum wa ja'alnaahum linnaasi Aayatanw wa a'tadnaa lizzaalimeena 'azaaban aleemaa
ayahs.en: And the people of Noah - when they denied the messengers, We drowned them, and We made them for mankind a sign. And We have prepared for the wrongdoers a painful punishment.

ayahs.ar: وَّعَادًا وَّثَمُوۡدَا۠ وَاَصۡحٰبَ الرَّسِّ وَقُرُوۡنًاۭ بَيۡنَ ذٰلِكَ كَثِيۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Wa 'Aadanw Samooda wa As haabar Rassi wa quroonam baina zaalika kaseeraa
ayahs.en: And [We destroyed] 'Aad and Thamud and the companions of the well and many generations between them.

ayahs.ar: وَكُلًّا ضَرَبۡنَا لَهُ الۡاَمۡثَالَؗ وَكُلًّا تَبَّرۡنَا تَتۡبِيۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Wa kullandarabnaa lahul amsaala wa kullan tabbarnaa tatbeera
ayahs.en: And for each We presented examples [as warnings], and each We destroyed with [total] destruction.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَتَوۡا عَلَي الۡقَرۡيَةِ الَّتِيۡ٘ اُمۡطِرَتۡ مَطَرَ السَّوۡءِؕ اَفَلَمۡ يَكُوۡنُوۡا يَرَوۡنَهَاۚ بَلۡ كَانُوۡا لَا يَرۡجُوۡنَ نُشُوۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad ataw 'alal qaryatil lateee umtirat mataras saw'; afalam yakoonoo yarawnahaa; bal kaanoo laa yarjoona nushooraa
ayahs.en: And they have already come upon the town which was showered with a rain of evil. So have they not seen it? But they are not expecting resurrection.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا رَاَوۡكَ اِنۡ يَّتَّخِذُوۡنَكَ اِلَّا هُزُوًاؕ اَهٰذَا الَّذِيۡ بَعَثَ اللّٰهُ رَسُوۡلًا
ayahs.tl: Wa izaa ra awka iny yattakhizoonaka illaa huzuwan ahaazal lazee ba'asal laahu Rasoolaa
ayahs.en: And when they see you, [O Muhammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one whom Allah has sent as a messenger?

ayahs.ar: اِنۡ كَادَ لَيُضِلُّنَا عَنۡ اٰلِهَتِنَا لَوۡلَا٘ اَنۡ صَبَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهَاؕ وَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ حِيۡنَ يَرَوۡنَ الۡعَذَابَ مَنۡ اَضَلُّ سَبِيۡلًا
ayahs.tl: In kaada la yudillunaa 'an aalihatinaa law laaa an sabarnaa 'alaihaa; wa sawfa ya'lamoona heena yarawnal 'azaaba man adallu sabeela
ayahs.en: He almost would have misled us from our gods had we not been steadfast in [worship of] them." But they are going to know, when they see the punishment, who is farthest astray in [his] way.

ayahs.ar: اَرَءَيۡتَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ اِلٰهَهٗ هَوٰىهُؕ اَفَاَنۡتَ تَكُوۡنُ عَلَيۡهِ وَكِيۡلًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Ara'aita manit takhaza ilaahahoo hawaahu afa anta takoonu 'alaihi wakeelaa
ayahs.en: Have you seen the one who takes as his god his own desire? Then would you be responsible for him?

ayahs.ar: اَمۡ تَحۡسَبُ اَنَّ اَكۡثَرَهُمۡ يَسۡمَعُوۡنَ اَوۡ يَعۡقِلُوۡنَؕ اِنۡ هُمۡ اِلَّا كَالۡاَنۡعَامِ بَلۡ هُمۡ اَضَلُّ سَبِيۡلًاࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Am tahsabu annna aksarahum yasma'oona aw ya''qiloon; in hum illaa kal an'aami bal hum adallu sabeelan
ayahs.en: Or do you think that most of them hear or reason? They are not except like livestock. Rather, they are [even] more astray in [their] way.

ayahs.ar: اَلَمۡ تَرَ اِلٰي رَبِّكَ كَيۡفَ مَدَّ الظِّلَّۚ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ لَجَعَلَهٗ سَاكِنًاۚ ثُمَّ جَعَلۡنَا الشَّمۡسَ عَلَيۡهِ دَلِيۡلًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Alam tara ilaa Rabbika kaifa maddaz zilla wa law shaaa'a laja'alahoo saakinan summa ja'alnash shamsa 'alaihe daleelaa
ayahs.en: Have you not considered your Lord - how He extends the shadow, and if He willed, He could have made it stationary? Then We made the sun for it an indication.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ قَبَضۡنٰهُ اِلَيۡنَا قَبۡضًا يَّسِيۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Summa qabadnaahu ilainaa qabdany yaseeraa
ayahs.en: Then We hold it in hand for a brief grasp.

ayahs.ar: وَهُوَ الَّذِيۡ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الَّيۡلَ لِبَاسًا وَّالنَّوۡمَ سُبَاتًا وَّجَعَلَ النَّهَارَ نُشُوۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Wa Huwal lazee ja'ala lakumul laila libaasanw wannawma subaatanw wa ja'alan nahaara nushooraa
ayahs.en: And it is He who has made the night for you as clothing and sleep [a means for] rest and has made the day a resurrection.

ayahs.ar: وَهُوَ الَّذِيۡ٘ اَرۡسَلَ الرِّيٰحَ بُشۡرًاۭ بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡ رَحۡمَتِهٖۚ وَاَنۡزَلۡنَا مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً طَهُوۡرًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa Huwal lazeee arsalar riyaaha bushram baina yadai rahmatih; wa anzalnaa minas samaaa'i maaa'an tahooraa
ayahs.en: And it is He who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy, and We send down from the sky pure water

ayahs.ar: لِّنُحۡيِۦَ بِهٖ بَلۡدَةً مَّيۡتًا وَّنُسۡقِيَهٗ مِمَّا خَلَقۡنَا٘ اَنۡعَامًا وَّاَنَاسِيَّ كَثِيۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Linuhyiya bihee balda tam maitanw wa nusqiyahoo mimmaa khalaqnaaa an'aa manw wa anaasiyya kaseeraa
ayahs.en: That We may bring to life thereby a dead land and give it as drink to those We created of numerous livestock and men.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ صَرَّفۡنٰهُ بَيۡنَهُمۡ لِيَذَّكَّرُوۡاؗۖ فَاَبٰ٘ي اَكۡثَرُ النَّاسِ اِلَّا كُفُوۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad sarrafnaahu bainahum li yazzakkaroo fa abaaa aksarun naasi illaa kufooraa
ayahs.en: And We have certainly distributed it among them that they might be reminded, but most of the people refuse except disbelief.

ayahs.ar: وَلَوۡ شِئۡنَا لَبَعَثۡنَا فِيۡ كُلِّ قَرۡيَةٍ نَّذِيۡرًاؗۖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa law shi'naa laba'asnaa fee kulli qar yatin nazeeraa
ayahs.en: And if We had willed, We could have sent into every city a warner.

ayahs.ar: فَلَا تُطِعِ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ وَجَاهِدۡهُمۡ بِهٖ جِهَادًا كَبِيۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Falaa tuti'il kaafireena wa jaahidhum bihee jihaadan kabeeraa
ayahs.en: So do not obey the disbelievers, and strive against them with the Qur'an a great striving.

ayahs.ar: وَهُوَ الَّذِيۡ مَرَجَ الۡبَحۡرَيۡنِ هٰذَا عَذۡبٌ فُرَاتٌ وَّهٰذَا مِلۡحٌ اُجَاجٌۚ وَجَعَلَ بَيۡنَهُمَا بَرۡزَخًا وَّحِجۡرًا مَّحۡجُوۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Wa Huwal lazee marajal bahraini haazaa 'azbun furaatunw wa haazaa milhun ujaaj; wa ja'ala bainahumaa barzakhanw wa hijram mahjooraa
ayahs.en: And it is He who has released [simultaneously] the two seas, one fresh and sweet and one salty and bitter, and He placed between them a barrier and prohibiting partition.

ayahs.ar: وَهُوَ الَّذِيۡ خَلَقَ مِنَ الۡمَآءِ بَشَرًا فَجَعَلَهٗ نَسَبًا وَّصِهۡرًاؕ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Wa Huwal lazee khalaqa minal maaa'i basharran fa ja'alahoo nasaban wa sihraa; wa kaana Rabbuka Qadeeraa
ayahs.en: And it is He who has created from water a human being and made him [a relative by] lineage and marriage. And ever is your Lord competent [concerning creation].

ayahs.ar: وَيَعۡبُدُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ مَا لَا يَنۡفَعُهُمۡ وَلَا يَضُرُّهُمۡؕ وَكَانَ الۡكَافِرُ عَلٰي رَبِّهٖ ظَهِيۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Wa ya'budoona min doonil laahi maa laa yanfa'uhum wa laa yadurruhum; wa kaanal kaafiru 'alaa Rabbihee zaheeraa
ayahs.en: But they worship rather than Allah that which does not benefit them or harm them, and the disbeliever is ever, against his Lord, an assistant [to Satan].

ayahs.ar: وَمَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنٰكَ اِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَّنَذِيۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Wa maa arsalnaaka illaa mubashshiranw wa nazeeraa
ayahs.en: And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ مَا٘ اَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ اَجۡرٍ اِلَّا مَنۡ شَآءَ اَنۡ يَّتَّخِذَ اِلٰي رَبِّهٖ سَبِيۡلًا
ayahs.tl: Qul maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin illaa man shaaa'a ai yattakhiza ilaa Rabbihee sabeelaa
ayahs.en: Say, "I do not ask of you for it any payment - only that whoever wills might take to his Lord a way."

ayahs.ar: وَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَي الۡحَيِّ الَّذِيۡ لَا يَمُوۡتُ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِهٖؕ وَكَفٰي بِهٖ بِذُنُوۡبِ عِبَادِهٖ خَبِيۡرَاۚۛۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa tawakkal 'alal Haiyil lazee laa yamootu wa sabbih bihamdih; wa kafaa bihee bizunoobi 'ibaadihee khabeeraa
ayahs.en: And rely upon the Ever-Living who does not die, and exalt [Allah] with His praise. And sufficient is He to be, with the sins of His servants, Acquainted -

ayahs.ar: اِۨلَّذِيۡ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فِيۡ سِتَّةِ اَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسۡتَوٰي عَلَي الۡعَرۡشِۚۛ اَلرَّحۡمٰنُ فَسۡـَٔلۡ بِهٖ خَبِيۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Allazee khalaqas samaawaati wal arda wa maa bainahumaa fee sittati aiyaamin summmmastawaa 'alal 'Arsh; ar Rahmaanu fas'al bihee khabeeraa
ayahs.en: He who created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days and then established Himself above the Throne - the Most Merciful, so ask about Him one well informed.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا قِيۡلَ لَهُمُ اسۡجُدُوۡا لِلرَّحۡمٰنِۚ قَالُوۡا وَمَا الرَّحۡمٰنُࣗ اَنَسۡجُدُ لِمَا تَاۡمُرُنَا وَزَادَهُمۡ نُفُوۡرًاࣛࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa izaa qeela lahumus judoo lir Rahmaani qaaloo wa mar Rahmaanu anasjudu limaa taamurunaa wa zaadahum nufooraa
ayahs.en: And when it is said to them, "Prostrate to the Most Merciful," they say, "And what is the Most Merciful? Should we prostrate to that which you order us?" And it increases them in aversion.

ayahs.ar: تَبٰرَكَ الَّذِيۡ جَعَلَ فِي السَّمَآءِ بُرُوۡجًا وَّجَعَلَ فِيۡهَا سِرٰجًا وَّقَمَرًا مُّنِيۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Tabaarakal lazee ja'ala fis samaaa'i buroojanw wa ja'ala feehaa siraajanw wa qamaram muneeraa
ayahs.en: Blessed is He who has placed in the sky great stars and placed therein a [burning] lamp and luminous moon.

ayahs.ar: وَهُوَ الَّذِيۡ جَعَلَ الَّيۡلَ وَالنَّهَارَ خِلۡفَةً لِّمَنۡ اَرَادَ اَنۡ يَّذَّكَّرَ اَوۡ اَرَادَ شُكُوۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Wa huwal lazee ja'alal laila wannahaara khilfatal liman araada ai yazzakkara aw araadaa shookooraa
ayahs.en: And it is He who has made the night and the day in succession for whoever desires to remember or desires gratitude.

ayahs.ar: وَعِبَادُ الرَّحۡمٰنِ الَّذِيۡنَ يَمۡشُوۡنَ عَلَي الۡاَرۡضِ هَوۡنًا وَّاِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ الۡجٰهِلُوۡنَ قَالُوۡا سَلٰمًا
ayahs.tl: Wa 'ibaadur Rahmaanil lazeena yamshoona 'alal ardi hawnanw wa izaa khaata bahumul jaahiloona qaaloo salaamaa
ayahs.en: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily, and when the ignorant address them [harshly], they say [words of] peace,

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ يَبِيۡتُوۡنَ لِرَبِّهِمۡ سُجَّدًا وَّقِيَامًا
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena yabeetoona li Rabbihim sujjadanw wa qiyaamaa
ayahs.en: And those who spend [part of] the night to their Lord prostrating and standing [in prayer]

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ رَبَّنَا اصۡرِفۡ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَࣗۖ اِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًاࣗۖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena yaqooloona Rabbanas rif 'annnaa 'azaaba Jahannama inn 'azaabahaa kaana gharaamaa
ayahs.en: And those who say, "Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering;

ayahs.ar: اِنَّهَا سَآءَتۡ مُسۡتَقَرًّا وَّمُقَامًا
ayahs.tl: Innahaa saaa'at mustaqarranw wa muqaamaa
ayahs.en: Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence."

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ اِذَا٘ اَنۡفَقُوۡا لَمۡ يُسۡرِفُوۡا وَلَمۡ يَقۡتُرُوۡا وَكَانَ بَيۡنَ ذٰلِكَ قَوَامًا
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena izaaa anfaqoo lam yusrifoo wa lam yaqturoo wa kaana baina zaalika qawaamaa
ayahs.en: And [they are] those who, when they spend, do so not excessively or sparingly but are ever, between that, [justly] moderate

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ لَا يَدۡعُوۡنَ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَ وَلَا يَقۡتُلُوۡنَ النَّفۡسَ الَّتِيۡ حَرَّمَ اللّٰهُ اِلَّا بِالۡحَقِّ وَلَا يَزۡنُوۡنَؕۚ وَمَنۡ يَّفۡعَلۡ ذٰلِكَ يَلۡقَ اَثَامًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena laa yad'oona ma'al laahi ilaahan aakhara wa laa yaqtuloonan nafsal latee harramal laahu illaa bilhaqqi wa laa yaznoon; wa mai yaf'al zaalika yalqa asaamaa
ayahs.en: And those who do not invoke with Allah another deity or kill the soul which Allah has forbidden [to be killed], except by right, and do not commit unlawful sexual intercourse. And whoever should do that will meet a penalty.

ayahs.ar: يُّضٰعَفۡ لَهُ الۡعَذَابُ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ وَيَخۡلُدۡ فِيۡهٖ مُهَانًاࣗۖ‏
ayahs.tl: Yudaa'af lahul 'azaabu Yawmal Qiyaamati wa yakhlud feehee muhaanaa
ayahs.en: Multiplied for him is the punishment on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein humiliated -

ayahs.ar: اِلَّا مَنۡ تَابَ وَاٰمَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًا صَالِحًا فَاُولٰٓئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ اللّٰهُ سَيِّاٰتِهِمۡ حَسَنٰتٍؕ وَكَانَ اللّٰهُ غَفُوۡرًا رَّحِيۡمًا
ayahs.tl: Illaa man taaba wa 'aamana wa 'amila 'amalan saalihan fa ulaaa'ika yubad dilul laahu saiyi aatihim hasanaat; wa kaanal laahu Ghafoorar Raheemaa
ayahs.en: Except for those who repent, believe and do righteous work. For them Allah will replace their evil deeds with good. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful.

ayahs.ar: وَمَنۡ تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَاِنَّهٗ يَتُوۡبُ اِلَي اللّٰهِ مَتَابًا
ayahs.tl: Wa man taaba wa 'amila saalihan fa innnahoo yatoobu ilal laahi mataabaa
ayahs.en: And he who repents and does righteousness does indeed turn to Allah with [accepted] repentance.

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ لَا يَشۡهَدُوۡنَ الزُّوۡرَۙ وَاِذَا مَرُّوۡا بِاللَّغۡوِ مَرُّوۡا كِرَامًا
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena laa yash hadoonaz zoora wa izaa marroo billaghwi marroo kiraamaa
ayahs.en: And [they are] those who do not testify to falsehood, and when they pass near ill speech, they pass by with dignity.

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ اِذَا ذُكِّرُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ لَمۡ يَخِرُّوۡا عَلَيۡهَا صُمًّا وَّعُمۡيَانًا
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena izaa zukkiroo bi Aayaati Rabbihim lam yakhirroo 'alaihaa summanw wa'umyaanaa
ayahs.en: And those who, when reminded of the verses of their Lord, do not fall upon them deaf and blind.

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ رَبَّنَا هَبۡ لَنَا مِنۡ اَزۡوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيّٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ اَعۡيُنٍ وَّاجۡعَلۡنَا لِلۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ اِمَامًا
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena yaqooloona Rabbanaa hab lanaa min azwaajinaa wa zurriyaatinaa qurrata a'yuninw waj 'alnaa lilmuttaqeena Imaamaa
ayahs.en: And those who say, "Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous."

ayahs.ar: اُولٰٓئِكَ يُجۡزَوۡنَ الۡغُرۡفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُوۡا وَيُلَقَّوۡنَ فِيۡهَا تَحِيَّةً وَّسَلٰمًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Ulaaa'ika yujzawnal ghurfata bimaa sabaroo wa yulaqqawna feehaa tahiyyatanw wa salaamaa
ayahs.en: Those will be awarded the Chamber for what they patiently endured, and they will be received therein with greetings and [words of] peace.

ayahs.ar: خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَاؕ حَسُنَتۡ مُسۡتَقَرًّا وَّمُقَامًا
ayahs.tl: Khaalideena feehaa; hasunat mustaqarranw wa muqaamaa
ayahs.en: Abiding eternally therein. Good is the settlement and residence.

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ مَا يَعۡبَؤُا بِكُمۡ رَبِّيۡ لَوۡلَا دُعَآؤُكُمۡۚ فَقَدۡ كَذَّبۡتُمۡ فَسَوۡفَ يَكُوۡنُ لِزَامًاࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Qul maa ya'ba'u bikum Rabbee law laa du'aaa'ukum faqad kazzabtum fasawfa yakoonu lizaamaa
ayahs.en: Say, "What would my Lord care for you if not for your supplication?" For you [disbelievers] have denied, so your denial is going to be adherent.
